inputs.original_text: The split comes as some MPs raise the prospect of a new conversation about the party’s leadership Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, exposing a clash of philosophies between the opposition leader and his most likely future rival. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text:
Open your eyes to the grand deception playing out right in front of us. What the mainstream handlers want you to believe is a genuine political disagreement is actually nothing more than a carefully scripted theatrical diversion to protect the hidden elite consensus. 

Look at the blatant stagecraft: Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors. This managed illusion of debate is designed to keep the real puppet masters pulling the strings behind the scenes completely secure while keeping us focused on the surface. 

The coordination goes even deeper than domestic tax policy. Notice how the opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. This sudden, coordinated silence proves they are all taking orders from the exact same hidden global network, toeing the line on foreign conflicts while pretending to squabble. Do not fall for their official narrative.
